title: A content worker whose edit moves an article's lines re-points each path:line citation into it past the edit before it hands back
goal: A content item whose change adds or removes lines in an article finds each path:line citation into that article from the root's articles and ledgers past the first changed line and re-points it to the same fact (check.py only proves a citation lands on some fact line), so a landing's sync gate does not stop on a shifted citation as BG-tl74zfyr's did on _gaps.md:801
notes: SP-xt4t63xw retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator. Evidence: ops SP-xt4t63xw land.step BG-tl74zfyr step=kbgit.py-sync-push exit=1 (check.py: _gaps.md:801 cites doc-lookup-sources.md:72, no fact line, after the split facts moved the article down 4 lines); the orchestrator dropped the done commit, widened the touches to _gaps.md and re-pointed the citation to :77.
